OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
During the event, invite friends to register and complete futures trading to earn lucky draw entries, with BTC or ETH guaranteed on every draw. Friends can also complete advanced trading tasks to earn up to $32 in BTC.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 24, 2026, 08:00 - December 3, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
How to Participate: Invite friends to complete designated tasks to earn lucky draw entries.
Event Rewards: Rewards include BTC and ETH and are available in limited quantities on a first-come, first-served basis. The prize pool refreshes daily at 00:00 (UTC). If the prize pool is exhausted on the final day, the event will end automatically.
Reminder: Please avoid frequent actions within a short period, as this may trigger risk controls and affect your lucky draw or reward claims.
## Event 1: Invite Friends to Trade and Win BTC or ETH, Guaranteed
During the event, invite one friend to register and complete identity verification. Once your friend reaches 2,000 USDT in futures trading volume, you will receive one lucky draw entry. Each inviter can earn up to five entries. Every draw guarantees a prize worth up to $5,000. Event 1 features a $50,000 reward pool in BTC and ETH. Rewards are credited instantly on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Event 2: Friends Trade More and Earn Up to $32 in BTC
During the event, friends who complete the Event 1 task can earn rewards based on their cumulative futures trading volume. Each friend may claim only the highest reward tier achieved, with a maximum reward of $32 in BTC. Event 2 features a $20,000 BTC reward pool, distributed in the order tasks are completed while supplies last.
- Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 5,000 USDT: Earn $2 in BTC
- Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 20,000 USDT: Earn $5 in BTC
- Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 50,000 USDT: Earn $10 in BTC
- Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 200,000 USDT: Earn $20 in BTC
- Cumulative futures trading volume ≥ 1,000,000 USDT: Earn $32 in BTC
## Notes
- Participants must click the “Join Now” button on the event page to register and complete identity verification to receive rewards. Registration is currently unavailable in certain regions. Please refer to the event page for availability.
- Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume. During the event, trading volume generated from USD1 Futures pairs will count at 50% toward event tasks, while trading volume from USDT Futures pairs will count in full.
- Event 1 lucky draw rewards will be distributed as Spot tokens and credited instantly. Event 2 rewards will be credited to users’ accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
- Invitees must register using the inviter’s exclusive referral code to qualify for rewards.
- Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
- Market makers, corporate accounts, institutional accounts, agents, and their sub-agents are not eligible to participate.
- If users participate in multiple referral events held during the same period, rewards cannot be claimed repeatedly. Users may receive rewards from only one referral event.
- If there is any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event due to changing market conditions, fraud risks, and other factors.
- Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot access all or part of the services, including participation in this event, games, or competitions. For more information about restricted regions, please refer to the User Agreement . We do not intend to solicit or market to customers in these restricted regions.

Headline: Hold U in Any Binance Accounts to Earn Up to 1.8x the Base APR
Prize pool: 1.5M U
Start: 2026-11-27T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-25T00:00:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Disclaimer: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Terms and conditions apply.
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is launching an airdrop campaign for U (United Stables). Eligible users who hold U on Binance automatically qualify for weekly U rewards from a 1,500,000 U prize pool. Grow your U holdings or trade U pairs to earn up to 1.8x the base APR.
Campaign Period: 2026-11-27 00:00 (UTC) - 2026-12-25 00:00 (UTC)
Prize Pool: 1,500,000 U
Distribution: Rewards start accruing from 2026-11-27 00:00 (UTC). Weekly rewards will be distributed directly to eligible users' Spot Accounts of their Binance master accounts in U tokens within 3 working days after each weekly reward period ends. Distribution records can be found in distribution history.
Distribution Frequency: Weekly airdrops during the Campaign Period
## How to Participate
All your eligible U earns the base APR. Grow your holdings or trade U pairs to earn a higher APR on part or all of your U.
 | Eligibility | U Boost Details | APR
Base | Hold U in any eligible account | All your eligible U earns the base APR. Eligible U is the U you own, after deducting any U you have borrowed and any U bought with borrowed stablecoins. | Base APR
New Holding Bonus | Hold more U than your own average over the previous 3 weeks | The additional amount above your average ("New U") earns 1.5x. U bought with newly deposited funds, or with USDT, BTC, fiat or any other asset you own, counts in full. Converting USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD already on Binance into U does not count as New U. U received from other Binance users does not count as New U. | 1.5x Base APR
Trading Bonus | Trade at least 2,500 U-equivalent of U pairs in a week | Trading volume across Spot, Margin and Futures is combined. U-versus-stablecoin pairs do not count. Once you reach the threshold, your eligible U held outside Simple Earn ("Trading U") earns 1.3x for the full week. | 1.3x Base APR
New + Trading | Meet both conditions above | U that is both New U and Trading U earns 1.8x. | 1.8x Base APR
U in Simple Earn Flexible Products continues to earn its own Real-Time APR, which is paid separately under Simple Earn terms. Campaign rewards are separate from the Real-Time APR.
## Eligible Accounts
Spot Account,
Funding Account,
Simple Earn Flexible Holdings,
Margin Account (Cross Margin, Isolated Margin or Portfolio Margin),
USDⓈ-M Futures Account (account balance only, Multi-Assets mode included; unrealized PnL is excluded).
U-pair trading volume is counted across Spot, Margin and Futures Accounts combined. U-versus-stablecoin pairs do not count.
## What Counts
Only your own U counts. Any U you have borrowed does not qualify under the campaign rules.
U funded by borrowed stablecoins does not count. If you borrow USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD and no longer hold it, the amount you no longer hold is deducted from your U.
Switching between stablecoins is not new U. Converting USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD already on Binance into U does not earn the New Holding Bonus. U bought with newly deposited funds, or with USDT, BTC, fiat or any other asset you own, counts in full.
U received from other users is not New U. U received from other Binance accounts earns the base APR but does not earn the New Holding Bonus.
Balances are checked every hour. Your lowest balance of the day is counted as your daily balance for the purposes of this campaign, and your weekly balance is the average of the 7 daily balances. A day with no balance counts as zero.
## Effective APR (to be updated after each weekly distribution)
Period | Base APR | New Holding 1.5x APR | Trading 1.3x APR | New + Trading 1.8x APR
1st Distribution on 2026-12-08Reward Period: 2026-11-27 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-04 00:00 (UTC) | To be updated by 2026-12-08 | To be updated by 2026-12-08 | To be updated by 2026-12-08 | To be updated by 2026-12-08
2nd Distribution on 2026-12-15Reward Period: 2026-12-04 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-11 00:00 (UTC) | To be updated by 2026-12-15 | To be updated by 2026-12-15 | To be updated by 2026-12-15 | To be updated by 2026-12-15
3rd Distribution on 2026-12-22Reward Period: 2026-12-11 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-18 00:00 (UTC) | To be updated by 2026-12-22 | To be updated by 2026-12-22 | To be updated by 2026-12-22 | To be updated by 2026-12-22
4th Distribution on 2026-12-29Reward Period: 2026-12-18 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-25 00:00 (UTC) | To be updated by 2026-12-29 | To be updated by 2026-12-29 | To be updated by 2026-12-29 | To be updated by 2026-12-29
## Examples
The examples below assume a base APR of 5% for illustration only. The actual effective APR for each week will be published after that week's distribution.
User A holds 10,000 U all week and held none in the previous 3 weeks. User A does not trade U pairs. All 10,000 U is New U and earns 1.5x.
Reward = 10,000 * 1.5 * 5% * 7 / 365 = 14.38 U
User B has held 10,000 U and 10,000 USDC for the past 3 weeks, then converts the USDC into U and holds 20,000 U all week. This is a switch between stablecoins, so it is not New U. All 20,000 U earns 1x.
Reward = 20,000 * 1 * 5% * 7 / 365 = 19.17 U
User C holds 1,000 U, borrows 4,000 USDT through Margin to buy 4,000 more U, and trades 3,000 U-equivalent of U pairs. User C held no U in the previous 3 weeks. The 4,000 U bought with borrowed USDT does not count. The remaining 1,000 U is both New U and Trading U, so it earns 1.8x.
Reward = 1,000 * 1.8 * 5% * 7 / 365 = 1.72 U
User D has kept 8,000 U in Simple Earn and 2,000 U in Spot for the past 3 weeks, unchanged, and trades 3,000 U-equivalent of U pairs this week. The 2,000 U in Spot earns 1.3x. The 8,000 U in Simple Earn earns 1x.
Reward = (8,000 * 1 + 2,000 * 1.3) * 5% * 7 / 365 = 10.16 U (Simple Earn's own yield is paid on top)
User E held no U in the previous 3 weeks. User E received 10,000 U from a friend’s Binance account, and User E holds it all week. The 10,000 U earns 1x, because U received from another Binance user is not New U.
Reward = 10,000 * 1 * 5% * 7 / 365 = 9.58 U
## Important Notes
Users' rewards depend on their eligible U, New U and Trading U relative to those of all eligible users, and other factors. The effective APRs will be published in this announcement after each weekly distribution.
Sub-accounts trading volumes are not counted as separate entries under this campaign. Sub-account balances and trading volume are aggregated at the master account level, and rewards are distributed only to the master account.
U borrowed through Margin or Loans (including interest), and any negative U balance in USDⓈ-M Futures, are treated as U liabilities and deducted from users’ U.
The same eligible accounts apply to all stablecoins. When checking net borrowing of stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD or XUSD), and when measuring holdings of USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD, only balances in the eligible accounts above are counted.
For borrowed stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD, including interest), the deduction is calculated for each coin separately. For example, if a user borrows 10,000 USDT and still holds 6,000 USDT, then 4,000 USDT will be deducted. Each liability is deducted only once across all their eligible accounts.
New U is measured against users’ own average over the 3 weeks before the current week. This reference amount is updated daily. If the user’s combined holdings of USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD fall below their combined 3-week average, that drop is deducted from their New U.
The Trading Bonus applies for the full week once the user’s cumulative U-pair trading volume reaches 2,500 U-equivalent within that campaign week. Trading volume is counted in U-equivalent, with both buy and sell sides counted. U-versus-stablecoin pairs (USDT, USDC, USD1, RLUSD, FDUSD and XUSD) are excluded.
At any snapshot, an eligible U balance below 0.01 U will be counted as zero.
Rewards distributed are rounded down to 2 decimal places. There is no individual cap on rewards. Kindly note that the distribution time is not guaranteed and may change from time to time.
If Binance identifies any abuse of the campaign rules, the related rewards will be cancelled, and Binance may disqualify the account from the campaign.
## Terms and Conditions
Only users who complete identity verification can qualify for rewards in the Campaign. The products or features referred to above may not be available in users’ region. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed. Currently, users residing in the following countries or regions will not be able to participate in the Campaign (notwithstanding that they may hold U):
Åland Islands (Finland), Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Crimea (Ukraine – disputed territory), Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, Donetsk People’s Republic, Estonia, Faroe Islands, Finland, France, French Guiana, Germany, Gibraltar, Greece, Guadeloupe, Guernsey, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Isle of Man, Islamic Republic of Iran, Italy, Japan, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luhansk People’s Republic, Luxembourg, Malta, Martinique, Mayotte, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Republic of Cuba, Réunion, Romania, Russian Federation, Saint Martin (French part), Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, United Kingdom, United States of America and its territories.
Please note that the list of excluded countries provided here is not exhaustive and may be subject to changes due to evolving local rules, regulations, or other considerations. This list may be updated periodically to accommodate changes in legal, regulatory, or other factors.
Users may not be eligible for rewards if there are active restrictions on their accounts.
Broker accounts are not eligible for this campaign.
Snapshots of user balances and total qualifying balances will be taken at any point of time each hour to get users’ hourly balances in the above mentioned account categories. The lowest balance captured during those snapshots on each day will constitute their Qualifying Balance and be used to calculate their rewards.
All calculations and determinations regarding this campaign (including but not limited to eligible balances, trading volume and reward distribution) will be made by Binance at its sole discretion.
Users are solely responsible for determining, declaring, and paying any taxes, duties, levies, or other charges that may arise in connection with any rewards they receive under this Campaign, and for complying with any applicable reporting obligations. Binance does not accept any liability for a user’s tax position or for any failure by a user to meet their own tax obligations. Where required by applicable law, Binance may withhold, deduct, or report amounts to the relevant tax authorities. All reward amounts described in this Activity are stated before any such withholding or deduction.
Disclaimer: Digital asset prices can be volatile. The value of your investment may go down or up and you may not get back the amount invested. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. The APR is calculated weekly, and is expressed as an annualised percentage yield for illustrative purposes only. Each APR is not indicative of future results. The APR is likely to fluctuate week-to-week and the estimated rewards may differ from the actual rewards generated. APR is an estimate of rewards you will earn in cryptocurrency over the selected timeframe. It does not display the actual or predicted returns/yield in any fiat currency. Past performance is not a reliable predictor of future performance. You should only invest in products you are familiar with and where you understand the risks. You should carefully consider your investment experience, financial situation, investment objectives and risk tolerance and consult an independent financial adviser prior to making any investment. This material should not be construed as financial advice. For more information, see our Terms of Use, and our Risk Warning. To learn more about how to protect yourself, visit our Responsible Trading page.
